card.name: Words just before death or mortality
card.fires_on: Small linking or modifying words right before an expected "death", "died" or "mortality", such as "risk of", "cause of", "increased" and "all-cause". It is strongest in warnings about increased mortality.

modes.label: Risk or cause of death
modes.description: The word "of" after risk or cause, where "death" comes next.
modes.example: Antipsychotic drugs increase the all-cause risk<< of>> death in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis

modes.label: Inside all-cause mortality phrasing
modes.description: Words in the phrase leading up to mortality or death, such as increase, all-cause or increased.
modes.example: had<< increased>> mortality observed versus vancomycin

modes.label: Narrative dying
modes.description: A word in a story just before "died".
modes.example: but they<< both>> died in infancy

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict death-related words such as death, died and die next.
card.plain: It fires on the words just before "death" or "died", especially in mortality warnings.
